draft_key_information_units.information: Impero achieved 19% year-on-year growth in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to DKK 46.2M at end-2025, with EBITDA improving to DKK -3.1M (better end of revised guidance range).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights: 'ARR amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to a 19% year-on-year growth rate... EBITDA ended at DKK -3.1M which is in the better end of the revised EBITDA guidance range of DKK -5M to -3M (Company Announcement No. 19-2025)'. Management commentary confirms ARR growth and EBITDA improvement.

draft_key_information_units.information: The company maintained exceptionally low churn of 1% in 2025 (vs 2% in 2024) and achieved a Net Revenue Retention Rate (NRR) of 106%, with Average ARR per Account (ARPA) reaching a record DKK 228T.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights: 'Impero's ARR growth rate of 19% YoY was in the upper end... exceptionally low churn rate of 1% in 2025... NRR ended at 106% in 2025'. ARR development and SaaS metrics table confirms NRR, churn, and ARPA figures.

draft_key_information_units.information: Impero surpassed 200 customers by end-2025, with customer base diversification (40% of Danish C25 index, 22.5% of German DAX index) and reduced top-10 customer concentration to 20% of ARR.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... total customer coverage is 40% of the C25 index and 22.5% of the DAX index... top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025'.

draft_key_information_units.information: Growth was driven primarily by Denmark (22% YoY net new ARR growth) and DACH region (26% YoY growth, 44% of total ARR), with strategic expansion planned for UK, Nordics, and Benelux markets.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In Denmark... 22% YoY... DACH region... 26% growth YoY... ARR from other markets declined to DKK 5.5M... strategic focus to expand... UK as well as Benelux'. Management commentary details regional performance and expansion plans.

draft_key_information_units.information: Key product milestones included launch of Control Testing module in July 2025, AI-augmented engineering adoption, and initiation of Entity Management development planned for 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module... advancing our AI agenda... Entity Management – supporting segmentation across global enterprises... delivery planned for 2026'. Product milestones section details features and AI integration.

draft_key_information_units.information: Impero raised DKK 15M via directed issue in December 2025, ending 2025 with DKK 18.9M cash; the Board deferred the ambition for recurring cash flow positivity before end-2026 to fund growth investments.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Equity and capital: 'raised DKK 15M in a private placement in December 2025... equity stood at DKK 15.4M... cash position of DKK 18.9M'. Strategy update: 'Board of Directors believes that growth investments will create more long-term value than pursuing cash flow positivity before end of 2026... deferred its ambition... as announced in Company Announcement No. 3-2026'.

draft_key_information_units.information: The Board accelerated commercial investments for 2026 (including new hires) to increase ARR growth, expecting ARR of DKK 53-57M (+15-23% YoY) but EBITDA of DKK -2M to -1M due to higher costs.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026: 'Impero expects ARR to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... ARR growth rate of approx. 15% to 23%... EBITDA expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to -1M... new planned hires across commercial organization will increase cost base'. Strategy update details investment plans.

draft_key_information_units.information: Expansion of partner network in DACH region to five revenue-generating partners (including Big4 firms) complemented own channel, which generated 71% of new ARR in 2025 despite decision-making delays.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'expanded our partner network in Germany... five revenue generating partners in the DACH region... own channel led new ARR generation in 2025... new ARR from own channels constituted 71% of total new ARR'. Channel Split section confirms partner vs own channel contribution.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units cover headline financial performance (D1), core SaaS efficiency metrics (D2), customer base health and diversification (D3), geographic growth drivers and strategy (D4), product innovation (D5), capital position and strategic funding shift (D6), 2026 growth guidance with trade-offs (D7), and channel strategy execution (D8). All are material to understanding Impero's financial position, strategic direction, and future outlook per source content. Omitted routine governance, risk lists, accounting policies, and non-material operational details per instructions.
